propositions: When attestation classification raises an exception, apply_bugfix_size_gate maps INFRA to advisory finding, allowing changes to pass with LLM-Review +1 instead of failing closed.
A 525-line bug fix merged with LLM-Review +1 despite classification error being recorded in coverage, because the gate degraded infrastructure fault to advisory rather than abstaining.
The fix changes INFRA arm to set verdict to INDETERMINATE on classification error, preserving the error in coverage while preventing silent pass-through of unclassifiable bug fixes.
An already-BLOCK verdict must not be downgraded by infra classification error; the fix preserves existing BLOCK verdicts.
The review-bot adapter's existing fail-closed behavior for INDETERMINATE verdicts (mapping to `-1` vote, no `+1`) ensures unclassifiable oversized bug fixes cannot merge without manual intervention.
